qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Leading 5G RAN market share and essential cellular SEP patent portfolio, but structural customer concentration gives wireless telcos immense purchasing leverage, depressing pricing power and multi-cycle returns.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (Moat & Pricing Power). Operates in a structurally difficult telecom equipment oligopoly facing concentrated, price-sensitive telco buyers with high purchasing power. Multi-cycle ROIC falls well short of the 12% hurdle, burdened by cyclical operator capex declines and destructive M&A write-downs (SEK 43B+ Vonage impairment).
qualitative.evidence: Sub-12% multi-cycle GAAP ROIC, lack of pricing power against major wireless carriers, and massive capital destruction from the $6.2B Vonage acquisition resulting in over SEK 43B in goodwill impairments.
